scope: Executed bounded investigation of PMP22 association beyond RNA in matched acute-stress count matrices; causal and protein-flux questions remain separate.
stopping_reason: Two independently generated stress experiments analyzed, a calibrated context rejected on measured feature coverage, all planned available normalization/background checks executed, exact producer outputs registered and source-paper audit completed. No time/request cap forced stopping. Further useful work requires an independent same-condition experiment or RNA/flux information not represented by the inspected paired tables. Unrelated mTOR/translation-factor contexts can be screened separately but will not identify why this particular tunicamycin contrast occurs.

items.question: Does acute arsenite change PMP22 relative RPF beyond its matched poly(A)+ RNA abundance?
items.readout: Matched coding-region RPF/RNA counts, 40 uM arsenite 30 min, two independent preparations per condition
prerequisites: Full coding-background and representative transcript rule
items.finding: Small negative relative interaction (-0.2704 log2) with broad CI; membrane-relative effect -0.0721. CDS/total RNA and normalization sensitivities retain the modest result. No selective or equivalence claim.
items.limitation: Two biological preparations per condition; no explicit cross-condition block matching, positional profiles or calibrated target protein output.
items.next_action: Use as an independent context contrast, not exact-condition replication or a new selective mechanism.

items.question: Does the association response recur under tunicamycin, and is it attenuated with ISRIB?
items.readout: Four conditions, two biological preparations each, matched source-paper mRNA/RPF constituent counts
prerequisites: No version-stripping join across incompatible exports
items.finding: Descriptive interaction -1.0247 log2, broad CI including zero; RNA +0.9048 versus RPF -0.1199. ISRIB cotreatment remains negative (-0.8126), with only modest uncertain attenuation. Point-estimate ranks remain low after count matching; control ISR genes respond as expected. Export equivalence failed and was not forced.
items.limitation: RNA-selection chemistry unresolved, source all-expression table universe may be preselected; small n; no transcript-resolved RNA pool or transit/nascent-protein assay. Prediction was informal/unsealed, representation amended after count exposure.
items.next_action: Independent same-condition paired experiment with isoform-resolved RNA and calibrated protein completion; retain descriptive candidate status until then.

items.question: Can the available spike-calibrated context distinguish relative scaling from absolute target translation?
items.readout: GSE256237 HCT116 native paired counts and calibration context
prerequisites: Measured PMP22 feature in the deposited native count universe
items.finding: PMP22 coverage gate failed in the deposited 13,715-row count matrix and source ISR table; absence not zero. Identical RNA vectors in some arms are retained, not independent denominators.
items.limitation: The inspected processed table cannot estimate this target; no automatic raw sequencing processing is authorized.
items.next_action: Obtain an author-supplied complete target count/calibration representation or a new independently calibrated target experiment. Do not transfer this study's spike to HEK293T data.

items.question: Does a changed RNA isoform/pool or elongation explain the descriptive tunicamycin contrast rather than altered completed protein production?
items.readout: Context-matched RNA ends/RBP occupancy, positional footprints or run-off, nascent PMP22 and separately measured handling
prerequisites: No transfer of K562 contacts to HEK293T without evidence
Total/surface protein alone cannot partition synthesis and clearance
items.finding: Both RNA-ends and RBP answer dependencies reviewed with exact artifact hash/derivation checks. Basal HEK293 PAPERCLIP and GTEx model maps cannot validate acute HEK293T capture chemistry; region sensitivity cannot exclude shared selection bias. K562 PUM2 has four reproducible contacts but fails the joint RNA-response/depletion criteria; model-space retention does not establish stress occupancy. No binder can be assigned as mediator of the HEK293T RNA/RPF contrast, and a failed abundance screen does not exclude translation-only regulation. No context-matched protein-output result supplied.
items.limitation: Available gene-level counts cannot distinguish these mechanisms; further arithmetic on the same matrices would not add the missing measurement.
items.next_action: If mechanistic work is separately undertaken, verify RNA-feature occupancy/loading in the actual HEK293T stress context and validate perturbation efficacy alongside matched RNA/RPF and protein completion. Do not infer first-exon site escape, functional depletion or a translation mechanism from these peer proxies.
